fieldData.job-spec:
What is the job? 

Please note, this is a full time position. We are not accepting applications from agencies or people moderating other channels at the same time. 


Do you love all things Crypto? Are you well and truly stuck in the rabbit hole that is DeFi? Do you love chatting about all the new things you have just learned to other like-minded people? Then you could be our next Community Manager! 

We need an epic Community Manager who will be the champion of Radix and communicate all the comings and goings with Radix and our platform.  You will be a leader in the community and can talk to the hodlers, can back up the buidlr’s, know your coins from your tokens and meme like no one's business! 

You will be an advocate for the community by listening to them, acknowledging any areas for development (or concern) and directing the Radix leadership team on how best to help develop the ever growing community.

What will you be doing?

  • You will be setting, planning and implementing the community management strategies 
  • You will also be identifying and recruiting community moderators and “Radvocates” on relevant platforms/channels and working with them to ensure a clear message across the community
  • You will be looking at new and innovative ways to increase community engagement
  • You will work closer with the Social Media Manager and wider marketing team to organize and manage campaigns to boost brand awareness and engagement on community platforms

What skills do you need?

  • You have experience building an online community and keeping all those in it informed
  • You know how to build rapport and trust with people and you have had experience in building communities within Crypto
  • You have demonstrable experience using social media such as Reddit, Telegram and Discord 
  • You have a deep understanding of the Crypto world and can discuss topics with authority, in addition to this, you love learning and sharing new topics and articulating the latest updates in the industry
  • You have proven experience identifying and managing community representatives
  • You have exceptional written English communication to a native/fluent level
  • You are a confident but calm people-person. You are passionate about Crypto as much as you care about the people in the community

Who are we? 

At Radix, we're a team of like-minded thinkers who have long been convinced that we're living in the earliest stages of a global financial revolution. This revolution is being fuelled by decentralized finance (or DeFi for short), which is enabling an assortment of pioneering developers and entrepreneurs to re-invent almost every financial product that is currently traded and invested in traditional markets, without requiring central authorities or siloed infrastructure. DeFi has captured a great deal of attention and investment in the crypto-aware niche, growing assets under management from $1 billion to $40 billion in less than a year. Impressive as its growth has been, its current market size isn't even a rounding error on the over $111 trillion held in traditional finance. We're focused on what it will take to go from billions to trillions.

Radix went back to first principles to come up with the right technical solution—the first layer-one protocol built specifically for mainstream DeFi—and we have already tested out at over 1 million transactions per second. We're keenly aware that the need for an infinitely scalable platform is only one prerequisite among many for mass adoption, and we're also blazing new ground in the areas of purpose-built developer tools, user experiences, and regulatory integration.

We have forged a path deep into the future of what distributed ledger technology is going to look like and we need you to come and be part of the team that is making that happen right now.

In return for working with us, you get to work remotely on your own schedule (or the option to get a local co-working space if preferred), work at the cutting edge of new technology and benefit from an education budget to use to further develop your skills!

If this job sounds like it was made for you, then please apply directly here or email farrah@radixdlt.com for more information.
